Α.Π.Σ. Ατρόμητος Αθηνών}}, ''PAE APS Atromitos Athinon''), also simply known as '''Atromitos''' {{literally|Fearless}}), is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Peristeri]], a suburban city in the [[Athens#Athens Urban Area|Athens agglomeration]], that competes in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]]. Founded in 1923, club's home ground is [[Peristeri Stadium]]. In the past few years, Atromitos has established itself as one of the most competitive and strong clubs in Greece. They were [[Greek Football Cup#Performance by club|runners-up]] of the [[Greek Football Cup|Greek Cup]] in [[2010–11 Greek Cup|2011]] and [[2011–12 Greek Football Cup|2012]]{{cite web|url=http://www.atromitosfc.gr/el/club-el/history-el/the-two-final-el.html|title=The two Greek Cup finals|publisher=atromitosfc.gr|language=el}} and have had breakthrough runs in the league, finishing 4th in 2011–12, 3rd in [[2012–13 Super League Greece|2012–13]], 4th in [[2013–14 Super League Greece|2013–14]] and 4th as well in [[2014–15 Super League Greece|2014–15]] and [[2018–19 Super League Greece|2018–19]]. Their best performance in the league has been third place, which they have achieved in the [[1927–28 Panhellenic Championship|1928]] and [[2012–13 Super League Greece|2013]] seasons of the [[Super League Greece|Greek Championship]]."}}
